tests.productionCompile: Separate translation unit without KH2_STATUS_THREAD_DRAIN_TESTS; MSVC /O2 /W4.
tests.scope: Private synthetic memory and real threads belonging to the test process; no game code executed.

implementation: After all five entry gates are published, retain real handles for every enumerated process thread. The owner also has a retained handle so DWORD thread-ID reuse cannot transfer authority.

Preallocate and touch up to 2 MiB of snapshot storage before any suspension. Capture CONTEXT_FULL and the entire active RSP..StackBase span. Read the current TIB only after suspending a remote thread.
Resume the remote thread before inspecting the copy. A failed resume retains its handle and debt; subsequent owner-thread Poll or Close retries it before further work.

ResumePending exposes debt without acquiring metadata locks. The coordinator must defer Observer.Fault/Inspect and other lock-taking work until repayment; an interrupted thread could hold those locks.
Inspect RIP and every aligned eight-byte word. Any value in any original writer body remains PotentialWriter, including ordinary data. Missing or truncated copies remain Unknown.

The verified normal closure guarantees an active old writer has either a root RIP or an aligned retained root continuation. Therefore a complete negative scan is sufficient within this contract; positives do not prove a live writer.

Capture the current thread in a noinline frame kept alive throughout copying. Poll bounds the number of threads examined. Ready revalidates gates and requires all retained threads to be clear or exited.
Observed code/gate loss or failed resume faults confidence permanently. A separately bound Observer must still serialize arming and require no tracked native calls.
meaningfulCases: OldWriter calls a helper blocked in WaitForSingleObject; its root continuation prevents readiness even though current RIP is outside the root.
After OldWriter returns, the same thread remains alive and a fresh complete copy clears. The old copy remains positive and cannot be reused as a new observation.
Retained signaled handles prove exit; closed or wrong-ID handles, invalid TEBs, truncated buffers and preexisting suspend counts never clear.
Injected ResumeThread failure preserves debt, invalidates the snapshot and requires repayment. Foreign suspend counts are preserved.
Every byte in all five root ranges and every aligned fixture slot is checked, together with malformed boundaries and contexts.
limits: Conservative data matches can defer readiness indefinitely. No timeout or repeated frame count converts uncertainty to success.
The 2 MiB cap and thread budget bound bytes/work, not elapsed suspension time. Paging and kernel waits can take longer.

The normal-call proof excludes parked writer fibers, arbitrary exception callbacks, foreign SetThreadContext/stack writes, and concurrent foreign ResumeThread. Suspend counts cannot detect a foreign resume/re-suspend ABA.
R8D=0 in the recorded WaitForSingleObjectEx fallback disables ordinary alertable-wait APC dispatch only; it does not exclude special APCs or arbitrary external callbacks.
Code/import identity, exact roots, resident routing, process-lifetime objects and stable trusted API behavior must be supplied by the installer.
No TrainerBridge installation, typed STATUS IPC, Actor-provider integration or in-game validation is claimed.
